faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers to what families ask before they start.

whatIs.question: What is LittleFounders?
whatIs.answer: A family platform where kids and teens learn about money by making decisions in guided stories, with a Mentor at their side.

isFree.question: Is LittleFounders free?
isFree.answer: It is free to start. There is no paid plan today, and a Tutor account never asks for payment details.

tryWithoutAccount.question: Can my child try it without an account?
tryWithoutAccount.answer: Yes. Tap Start free to try it as a guest; progress stays in that browser.

languages.question: What languages does it support?
languages.answer: English, Spanish and Portuguese. Switch at any time from the language menu.

ages.question: What ages is this for?
ages.answer: Kids and teens, about 6 to 17. Under 13, a Tutor creates the account; teens can also sign up on their own.

whatIsTutor.question: What is a Tutor account?
whatIsTutor.answer: The account of a verified parent. You confirm your identity, and every child linked to you is yours to see and supervise.

addChild.question: How do I add my child?
addChild.answer: From your Tutor account: a name, a username and a passphrase you choose. Your child needs no email.

twoParents.question: Can both parents supervise the same child?
twoParents.answer: Yes. A second verified Tutor can join through a single-use invite from your panel that expires in 7 days, and you confirm them first.

howMany.question: How many children can I add?

ownDevice.question: Does my child need their own device?
ownDevice.answer: No. Child accounts work on a shared device, and each login is separate from yours.

talksToAI.question: Does my child talk to an AI?
talksToAI.answer: Yes, with a Mentor character who answers in text. Voice is off for minors by default and needs your consent.

privateFromYou.question: Is what my child tells the Mentor private?
privateFromYou.answer: From other users, yes. From you, no: you can read every exchange in full, not a summary.

remember.question: Can the Mentor remember things about my child?
remember.answer: Only with your approval. You see each proposed note beside the old one and approve or decline it.

mentors.question: Who are the Mentors?
mentors.answer: Your child chooses one of 4 characters, each with their own personality: Dina, Liruf, Dr. Rho or Zara.

canBeWrong.question: Can the Mentor be wrong?
canBeWrong.answer: Yes, it is an AI and can explain something imprecisely. Its replies to children are checked first and never replace your judgment.

realBank.question: Is this a real bank account?
realBank.answer: No. It is practice in coins, a simulation that never uses real money.

lfCoins.question: What are the coins?
lfCoins.answer: The app's practice currency. Kids earn them from tasks and lessons to practice saving, spending and sharing; they have no value outside the app.

chores.question: How do chores and rewards work?
chores.answer: You set a chore and its coins; your child splits them into save, spend and share. You approve each one, or let small ones through.

realMoney.question: Can my child spend real money?
realMoney.answer: No, nowhere in the product. LittleFounders never asks a child for payment details or moves real money.

notTaught.question: Does it teach credit, debt or investing?
notTaught.answer: The practice covers earning, splitting, saving and rewards. It skips credit, debt, compound interest, risk, investing and insurance, and the savings bonus is not interest.

dataCollected.question: What data do you collect about my child?
dataCollected.answer: Only what the product needs: for a child account, a nickname and an optional birth date. No full name, address or contact details.

moderation.question: Is everything the Mentor says checked first?
moderation.answer: Yes. For a child account, the Mentor's replies are checked before they are shown or spoken.

retention.question: How long do you keep Mentor conversations?
retention.answer: Up to 90 days, on a fixed automatic schedule.

noMessaging.question: Can my child message other people?
noMessaging.answer: No. There is no chat, messaging or comments between people, and anything like it would stay off for children unless their Tutor turns it on.

socialRetention.question: How long do you keep who follows whom?
socialRetention.answer: Follows and blocks last until removed or the account is deleted. Unanswered requests expire after 30 days, and closed ones go 30 days later.

familyRecords.question: How long do you keep chore records?
familyRecords.answer: Chore photos for 30 days after you decide; chores, rewards, decisions and notes for 400 days. Deleting your child's account deletes all of it.

analyticsToggle.question: Can I turn off my child's usage analytics?
analyticsToggle.answer: Yes, for each child, from your Tutor account. They stay off until you turn them on.

coppa.question: Do you follow children's privacy laws?
coppa.answer: Our Privacy Notice follows COPPA and LGPD standards for data minimization and parental consent. The full legal detail is there.

contact.question: How do I contact support?
contact.answer: Email informame@littlefounders.ai, or report a profile in the app: Report sits beside Block on every profile.

deleteAccount.question: Can I delete our account?
deleteAccount.answer: Yes, in Settings: it is deleted 14 days later unless you keep it. Guest accounts go at once; a Tutor deletes a child's.

cancelTutor.question: What if I cancel my account?
cancelTutor.answer: Your child's account is paused at once, until an active Tutor supervises it again. If nobody does within 90 days, it is deleted.
